body.name: Geometric-mixing frontier and iid spacing comparator
body.construction:
Define
\[
R_{\mathrm{sp},\beta}
=\left\{\frac{\log(T\vee2)}T\right\}^{2\lambda/d},
\qquad
R_{\star,\beta}
=R_{\mathrm{tr}}\vee R_{\mathrm{sm}}\vee
R_{\mathrm{sp},\beta}\vee R_{\mathrm{don}}.
\]
Here \(R_{\mathrm{tr}}=\sum_s\pi_s^2/n_s\),
\(R_{\mathrm{sm}}=\sum_s\pi_s^2(Tn_s)^{-2\lambda/(2\lambda+d)}\), and
\(R_{\mathrm{don}}=N^{-\kappa}\).  Retain
\[
R_{\mathrm{sp}}=T^{-2\lambda/d},
\qquad
R_\star=R_{\mathrm{tr}}\vee R_{\mathrm{sm}}\vee
R_{\mathrm{sp}}\vee R_{\mathrm{don}}
\]
only as the iid or fixed-query comparator.  For \(q\in\{\mathrm{tr},\mathrm{sm},\mathrm{sp},\mathrm{don}\}\), let \(R_q\) denote respectively \(R_{\mathrm{tr}},R_{\mathrm{sm}},R_{\mathrm{sp},\beta},R_{\mathrm{don}}\).
